recipe_version.title: Bengali Shorshe Maach: Haddock in Mustard-Seed Sauce with Rice
recipe_version.description: Turmeric-rubbed haddock seared lightly and simmered in a pungent Bengali sauce of freshly ground yellow and brown mustard seeds, green chiles, and nigella seeds, finished with a drizzle of mustard oil. Served with plain basmati rice.

ingredients.name: haddock fillets
ingredients.note: about 6 oz each; cod is the same-shopping swap

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 1/2 tsp fish, 1/2 tsp sauce, 1/2 tsp rice

ingredients.name: mustard oil labeled for cooking
ingredients.note: 2 tbsp cooking, 1 tbsp to finish; neutral oil is the swap

steps.title: Soak and prep
steps.body: Soak the yellow and brown mustard seeds in 1/3 cup water for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, rinse the rice, cut the fillets in half, rub them with 1/2 tsp turmeric and 1/2 tsp salt, slit 2 chiles, and chop the cilantro.

steps.title: Start the rice
steps.body: Combine the rice, 2 1/4 cups water, and 1/2 tsp salt in a 2-quart saucepan. Bring to a boil over high heat, cover, turn to low, and cook 12 minutes; then rest covered off the heat 10 minutes. This runs inside steps 3 to 5 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Grind the mustard paste
steps.body: Grind the soaked seeds with their 1/3 cup soaking water, 2 green chiles, 1/2 tsp turmeric, and 1/2 tsp salt in a spice grinder or small blender to a smooth paste, about 2 minutes, scraping down once.

steps.title: Sear the fish
steps.body: Heat 2 tbsp mustard oil in a 12-inch nonstick skillet over medium-high until it just starts to smoke, then lower the heat to medium. Sear the fish until lightly golden, about 2 minutes per side, and transfer to a plate.

steps.title: Simmer in the sauce
steps.body: Add the nigella seeds and slit chiles to the oil for 15 seconds. Stir the mustard paste with 3/4 cup water and pour it into the skillet; bring just to a simmer over medium-low without boiling. Return the fish, cover, and simmer gently until it flakes and reads 145 F, about 6 minutes. Drizzle the remaining 1 tbsp mustard oil over the top.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Fluff the rice and serve the fish and sauce beside it, scattered with cilantro.
